name: Ray Tracing Studio
description: Vanilla JavaScript path tracing studio with Canvas 2D rendering, Web Worker tile rendering, pure JS render/canvas presenter cores, progressive sample accumulation, adaptive tile variance, ray-sphere and ray-plane intersections, diffuse, metal, glass, and emissive materials, checker surfaces, depth of field, ACES tone mapping, direct lighting, preview denoise, viewport-fit controls, quality profiles, live ETA/ray metrics, pause/resume, unit-tested math/render helpers, and PNG/JSON export.
